name: DashCore
description: Android64 profiling with a read-only Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility-mask test over real scene objects. The original Geometry Dash renderer remains active; live experimental render culling stays opt-in.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling
experimental-render-culling.description: Experimental CPU off-screen render culling. Triggers and effects are protected. Grouped objects are protected near the player and may be culled only when distant. Off by default. The 0.7.0 GPU visibility-mask test is diagnostic only and never hides objects.
